environment.description: Same CI/CD dashboard plugin deployed on internal Kubernetes cluster. Split.io workspace 'prod-cicd' has the feature flag 'graphql_dynamic_query_builder' configured with default treatment 'off' and kill switch engaged (flag status: killed). The flag definition has no individual targeting rules, no percentage allocation, and the 'off' treatment maps to the else branch. Note: the Split SDK is initialized with the production API key bound to this workspace. The SDK's impression listener logs show consistent 'off' evaluations. Additionally, the Split admin API shows the flag was killed on 2024-01-15 and has not been modified since (audit log hash: sha256:a4f2e8...). The factory.block_until_ready(5) call succeeds in this environment, meaning the SDK has fully synced definitions before serving traffic.
